test_cases.name: local-only safety refuses remote API and database targets before connecting
concurrent joins, readiness and competing starts preserve every player and one match
capacity and expected revision are serialized under simultaneous commands
parallel retries return the durable original receipt; mismatched reuse is rejected
lost HTTP acknowledgement after commit retries exactly once after a different writer
replaying an acknowledged leave after rejoin preserves the new membership and reveals no secrets
a caller changing nested form data cannot rewrite a pending committed command
actual refused network request remains pending and reconnect resnapshots before retry
real Postgres Changes sockets converge and reconnect catches up from authoritative snapshots
a missed last WAL signal is recovered by bounded HTTP reconciliation while socket is disconnected
anonymous, outsider and peer privilege checks block snapshots, signals and secret tables
concurrent ballots finish one match and stale match commands cannot mutate a replay
leave and close race has one closed outcome with no lost membership update
first-delivery stale membership, settings and lobby intents are fenced independently of request replay
a locked room does not block the same user in another room; failed commands roll back
